instructions.name: back_contestant
docs: Stake on a contestant. Resolves against the underlying game program.

instructions.name: bind_market_to_game
docs: Binds a market to a specific game-state account so the permissionless
resolver can't be pointed at an unrelated finished game that happens to
have matching p1/p2 pubkeys. Called once per market, immediately after
`initialize_market` (usually atomically via Orchestrator CPI).
Authority = market.authority (the partner who created the market, can be
a PDA). Payer pays rent separately (so a data-carrying PDA authority
doesn't block `system_program::create_account`).

accounts.name: market
docs: The market being bound. Authority must sign to prove they created it.

accounts.name: game_program_registry_v2
docs: V2.1 registry entry for the game program whose state will resolve this market.

accounts.name: binding
docs: The binding PDA (new). Created once per market.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Market's partner authority — must sign to prove ownership of the market.
Can be a PDA (via CPI invoke_signed). Not mutable because rent payment
is delegated to `payer`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Rent payer — must be a regular wallet (or system-owned empty PDA).
Split from `authority` so PDAs with data can still authorize binds.

instructions.name: cancel_admin_action
docs: Admin cancels a queued proposal before timelock elapses. Closes PDA.

instructions.name: claim_backer_winnings
docs: Claim backer winnings after market resolution.
Payout = (your_stake / winning_pool) * total_backer_pool * (1 - fee)
Each winner calls this individually. Double-claim prevented by `claimed` flag.

instructions.name: close_market
docs: Close a fully settled market and reclaim rent.
Vault token account is closed (rent to authority).
Market account is closed via Anchor `close` constraint.

instructions.name: close_market_permissionless
docs: Permissionless close: anyone can reclaim rent from a fully-settled market
after the V2_CLOSE_COOLDOWN_SECONDS (48hr) window since creation. Rent
is always returned to the original creator (market.authority) — never
the caller — to prevent grief-close economics.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Original creator — receives all rent regardless of who calls this.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Whoever triggers the close. Pays the tx fee, receives nothing.

instructions.name: delegate
docs: Delegate a market account to an ephemeral rollup for high-frequency gameplay.
The `#[ephemeral]` macro intercepts this instruction to handle delegation via MagicBlock.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The market's authority (partner) must sign delegation.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit collateral into a market. Only P1 or P2 can deposit.

instructions.name: execute_admin_action
docs: Execute a queued admin action. Permissionless once timelock has elapsed
(anyone can crank). Closes the proposal PDA, refunding rent to admin.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Original admin who proposed — receives rent refund via `close = admin`.

accounts.name: executor
docs: Anyone can crank execution after the timelock elapses.

instructions.name: expire_market
docs: Permissionless expiry. Anyone can call after the market's `expires_at` timestamp.
Full refund to both players, no fees taken.

accounts.name: p1_token_account
docs: P1's token account for refund.

accounts.name: p2_token_account
docs: P2's token account for refund.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless: anyone can trigger expiry.

instructions.name: initialize_market
docs: Create a new 1v1 market with an associated token vault.
Only registered, active partners can initialize markets (Partner Handshake).

instructions.name: initialize_market_v21
docs: v2.1 market creation with separate payer + authority.
Mirrors `initialize_market` but `payer` pays rent and `authority` only
proves partner identity (can be a PDA via CPI invoke_signed).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Partner authority — signs to prove partnership. Can be a PDA via invoke_signed.
Not mutable — rent payment is delegated to `payer`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Rent payer — must be a regular wallet. Funds market + vault rent.

instructions.name: initialize_protocol
docs: One-time initialization of the global protocol configuration.
Sets the admin, treasury wallet, and protocol fee rate.

instructions.name: initialize_protocol_v2
docs: One-time initialization of the v2 protocol configuration PDA.
Stored at a SEPARATE PDA ("protocol_config_v2") — does not touch the v1
ProtocolConfig (which stays admin/treasury source-of-truth). Must be called
by the admin before any v2 instruction is usable.

accounts.name: protocol_config
docs: Admin authority (validated against v1 ProtocolConfig).

instructions.name: propose_admin_action
docs: Admin queues a timelocked action. `deadline` caps replay window per Drift class.
One proposal at a time per program; cancel before re-proposing.

instructions.name: register_game_program
docs: Admin registers a game program whose state accounts may be read by
`resolve_market_from_game_pda`. The game program's GameState accounts
must follow the V2 layout (see module-level constants).

instructions.name: register_game_program_v2
docs: Production v2.1 registry: admin declares a full adapter schema for each
game program, enabling permissionless resolve against ANY registered
game's state layout — not just the hardcoded v2.0 offsets.
Chess example: p1@16 (after 8-byte disc + 8-byte game_id prefix),
p2@48, status@80, winner@85, status_finished_value=2 (GameStatus::Finished),
winner_p1_value=1 (white wins), winner_p2_value=2 (black wins),
winner_draw_value=0 (status=Finished + winner=0 → draw).
Forward-compatible: Blockwords and PLA register their own offsets
without CM v2 upgrades.

instructions.name: register_partner
docs: Register a new partner (game engine / event source).
Only the protocol admin can register partners.

accounts.name: partner_treasury
docs: The partner's treasury wallet. Validated as a real token account.

instructions.name: resolve_market
docs: Resolve a market and distribute funds atomically.
Outcomes:
- 0 (P1 wins): Fees taken, remainder to P1.
- 1 (P2 wins): Fees taken, remainder to P2.
- 255 (Cancelled):
- If only one player deposited: free refund (game never started).
- If both deposited: protocol fee still taken (prevents strategic cancel abuse).

accounts.name: p1_token_account
docs: P1's token account to receive winnings or refund.

accounts.name: p2_token_account
docs: P2's token account to receive winnings or refund.

accounts.name: partner_treasury
docs: Partner's treasury token account for fee share.

accounts.name: protocol_treasury
docs: Protocol treasury token account for contention's fee share.

accounts.name: referrer_token_account
docs: Referrer's token account for referral fee. Optional — if no referrer, pass protocol_treasury as placeholder.

instructions.name: resolve_market_from_game_pda
docs: Permissionless resolve: anyone can settle a market whose referenced game
program has recorded a definitive winner. No partner key required.
Validation flow:
1. Market must not already be resolved (idempotency).
2. V2 must be initialized.
3. `game_state` account must be owned by a registered game program.
4. `game_state` layout must be V2-compliant (≥ 74 bytes).
5. `game_state` p1/p2 must match this market's p1/p2 (no cross-game hijack).
6. `game_state` status must be `finished` (2) and winner index valid.
7. Winner pubkey must match one of the market's declared players.
Fee math (v2 defaults, configurable via upgrade_protocol_to_v2):
protocol_fee     = total × protocol_fee_bps     / 10000   (default 80 bps)
partner_fee      = total × partner_fee_bps      / 10000   (default 100 bps)
pool_backer_fee = total × pool_backer_fee_bps / 10000   (default 20 bps)
winner_payout    = total − (all three fees)

accounts.name: protocol_config
docs: V1 ProtocolConfig — we only read `treasury` from here.

accounts.name: protocol_config_v2
docs: V2 ProtocolConfig — fee bps + PoolBacker live here.

accounts.name: game_program_registry_v2
docs: V2.1 registry with per-game adapter schema (replaces V2.0 fixed offsets).

accounts.name: market_game_binding
docs: Cryptographic binding market ↔ game_state. Created by `bind_market_to_game`
atomically with (or immediately after) market init. Prevents an attacker
from pointing resolve at a different finished game with matching p1/p2.

accounts.name: game_state
docs: The game program's state account. Owner + layout validated in handler
against the adapter schema declared in the registry.
account length ≥ adapter.min_account_len, binding.game_state match).

accounts.name: pool_backer
docs: PoolBacker's sentinel (checked against `config.pool_backer`).

accounts.name: pool_backer_treasury
docs: PoolBacker's token account (receives the 0.20% slice).

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Keeper who invokes permissionless resolve. Not paid by protocol;
pays their own tx fee. Any wallet works.

instructions.name: set_partner_active
docs: Activate or deactivate a partner. Admin only.

instructions.name: undelegate
docs: Return a market account from ephemeral rollup back to L1.
The `#[ephemeral]` macro intercepts this instruction to handle undelegation via MagicBlock.

instructions.name: update_partner_treasury
docs: Update the treasury wallet for a partner. Requires the current treasury to sign.

accounts.name: verified_treasury
docs: Current treasury wallet must sign to authorize the change.

accounts.name: new_treasury
docs: New treasury token account.

instructions.name: update_protocol_config
docs: Update protocol fee rate or treasury wallet. Admin only.

instructions.name: update_protocol_config_v2
docs: Admin may update v2 fee rates or PoolBacker destination. Each
component bounded by V2_MAX_COMPONENT_FEE_BPS.

errors.name: MarketAlreadyResolved
errors.msg: Market is already resolved.

errors.name: InvalidOutcome
errors.msg: Invalid outcome index. Must be 0 (P1), 1 (P2), or 255 (Cancel).

errors.name: PartnerInactive
errors.msg: Partner is not active in the registry.

errors.name: InvalidPartnerTreasury
errors.msg: Partner treasury does not match registry.

errors.name: InvalidProtocolTreasury
errors.msg: Protocol treasury does not match config.

errors.name: MarketNotResolved
errors.msg: Market has not been resolved yet.

errors.name: MarketNotSettled
errors.msg: Market has not been fully settled yet.

errors.name: UnauthorizedPartner
errors.msg: Signer is not the authorized partner for this market.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not the protocol admin.

errors.name: UnauthorizedPlayer
errors.msg: Signer is not P1 or P2 for this market.

errors.name: MetadataTooLong
errors.msg: Metadata exceeds maximum length of 512 bytes.

errors.name: DuplicatePlayers
errors.msg: P1 and P2 must be different wallets.

errors.name: ExpiryInPast
errors.msg: Expiry timestamp must be in the future.

errors.name: NoExpiry
errors.msg: Market has no expiry set.

errors.name: NotExpired
errors.msg: Market has not expired yet.

errors.name: VaultNotEmpty
errors.msg: Vault still contains tokens.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero.

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow.

errors.name: FeeTooHigh
errors.msg: Fee exceeds maximum allowed.

errors.name: MintMismatch
errors.msg: Token mint does not match market collateral.

errors.name: TokenOwnerMismatch
errors.msg: Token account owner does not match expected wallet.

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: Backer winnings already claimed.

errors.name: V2NotInitialized
errors.msg: V2 protocol upgrade has not been performed. Call upgrade_protocol_to_v2.

errors.name: V2AlreadyInitialized
errors.msg: V2 protocol has already been initialized.

errors.name: GameStateTooSmall
errors.msg: Game state account is too small to be a valid v2 game.

errors.name: UnregisteredGameProgram
errors.msg: Game program is not registered. Admin must add it via register_game_program.

errors.name: GameNotFinished
errors.msg: Game has not reached finished status yet.

errors.name: InvalidGameWinner
errors.msg: Game winner index is invalid (not 0 for P1, 1 for P2, or 255 for draw).

errors.name: WinnerNotInMarket
errors.msg: Winner from game state does not match either player in this market.

errors.name: GamePlayerMismatch
errors.msg: Game state p1/p2 do not match this market's p1/p2.

errors.name: InvalidPoolBacker
errors.msg: PoolBacker account does not match the one registered in protocol config.

errors.name: CloseCooldownActive
errors.msg: Market cannot be closed yet — 48-hour cooldown after creation still active.

errors.name: V2FeeTooHigh
errors.msg: Fee bps exceeds the v2 component ceiling (500 bps = 5%).

errors.name: V2AdapterOffsetTooLarge
errors.msg: Adapter offset exceeds the safety cap (16KB).

errors.name: V2AdapterOffsetOverflow
errors.msg: Adapter offset points outside the declared min_account_len.

errors.name: V2AdapterOffsetOverlap
errors.msg: Adapter p1/p2 pubkey slots overlap in the game state layout.

errors.name: V2AdapterWinnerValuesCollide
errors.msg: Adapter winner_p1/p2/draw values must all be distinct.

errors.name: BindingMarketMismatch
errors.msg: MarketGameBinding references a different market than the one being resolved.

errors.name: BindingGameStateMismatch
errors.msg: MarketGameBinding references a different game_state than the one provided.

errors.name: BindingGameProgramMismatch
errors.msg: MarketGameBinding references a different game_program than the registered one.

errors.name: DeadlineExceeded
errors.msg: Admin tx deadline has already passed (replay defense).

errors.name: DeadlineTooFar
errors.msg: Admin tx deadline is more than 7 days in the future (replay defense).

errors.name: NoTimelockProposal
errors.msg: No timelock proposal queued.

errors.name: TimelockNotElapsed
errors.msg: Timelock period has not elapsed yet.

errors.name: TimelockAlreadyQueued
errors.msg: A timelock proposal is already queued; cancel it first.

types.name: BackerStake
docs: Per-user stake on a contestant. PDA: ["backer_stake", market, backer].

types.name: GameAdapterSchema
docs: Per-game layout schema. Declared at v2.1 registration so `resolve_market_from_game_pda`
can read ANY registered game's state without hardcoding offsets. Safety-checked
at register-time (offsets in range, pubkey slots don't overlap, winner values distinct).

fields.name: p1_offset
docs: Byte offset of p1/white Pubkey in the game's state account.

fields.name: p2_offset
docs: Byte offset of p2/black Pubkey.

fields.name: status_offset
docs: Byte offset of the status byte.

fields.name: status_finished_value
docs: Value of the status byte that indicates "game is finished".

fields.name: winner_offset
docs: Byte offset of the winner byte.

fields.name: winner_p1_value
docs: Winner byte value meaning "p1/white wins".

fields.name: winner_p2_value
docs: Winner byte value meaning "p2/black wins".

fields.name: winner_draw_value
docs: Winner byte value meaning "draw / cancelled".

fields.name: min_account_len
docs: Minimum account length for the game state (declared by admin, re-checked at resolve).

types.name: GameProgramRegistry
docs: V2 game program allowlist. PDA: ["game_program_registry", game_program_id].
Admin-gated via `register_game_program`. Enables `resolve_market_from_game_pda`.

types.name: GameProgramRegistryV2
docs: V2.1 game program registry with adapter schema. PDA: ["game_program_registry_v2", game_program].
Replaces the V2.0 fixed-offset registry for new registrations.

types.name: MarketGameBinding
docs: Cryptographic binding market ↔ game_state. PDA: ["market_binding", market].
Created once per market immediately after `initialize_market`. Prevents the
permissionless resolver being pointed at an unrelated finished game.

types.name: MarketState
docs: 1v1 market state. PDA: ["market", event_id (u64 LE)].

fields.name: authority
docs: Partner authority that controls this market.

fields.name: mint
docs: Collateral token mint (e.g., USDC).

fields.name: p1
docs: Player 1 wallet.

fields.name: p2
docs: Player 2 wallet.

fields.name: event_id
docs: Unique event identifier.

fields.name: p1_deposit
docs: Amount P1 has deposited.

fields.name: p2_deposit
docs: Amount P2 has deposited.

fields.name: resolved
docs: Whether the market has been resolved.

fields.name: winning_outcome
docs: Winning outcome: Some(0)=P1, Some(1)=P2, None=cancelled/void.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp of market creation.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Unix timestamp after which anyone can expire the market. 0 = no expiry.

fields.name: referrer
docs: Referrer wallet that shared the challenge link. Earns 20% of protocol fee.

fields.name: backer_pool_p1
docs: Backer pool: total staked on P1.

fields.name: backer_pool_p2
docs: Backer pool: total staked on P2.

fields.name: settled
docs: Whether all funds have been distributed from the vault.

fields.name: bump
docs: Market PDA bump seed.

fields.name: vault_bump
docs: Vault PDA bump seed.

types.name: PartnerRegistry
docs: Registered partner. PDA: ["partner_registry", partner_program_id].

fields.name: partner_program_id
docs: The partner's signing authority keypair public key.

fields.name: verified_treasury
docs: The partner's treasury token account address for receiving fee share.

fields.name: fee_share_bps
docs: Partner's share of the protocol fee, in basis points.
E.g., 5000 = 50% of protocol fee goes to partner.

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Global protocol configuration (v1). Singleton PDA: ["protocol_config"].
Preserved as-is so the already-deployed devnet account continues to deserialize.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin wallet that can register partners and update config.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Treasury wallet address that receives contention's fee share.

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee in basis points (v1 meaning: total rake split between partner+contention).

types.name: ProtocolConfigV2
docs: V2 protocol configuration — SEPARATE PDA. Singleton: ["protocol_config_v2"].
Kept distinct from the v1 ProtocolConfig PDA to avoid touching the
already-deployed account's layout.

fields.name: pool_backer
docs: PoolBacker account whose treasury token account receives the 0.20% slice.

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: Protocol treasury slice (default 80 bps = 0.80%).

fields.name: partner_fee_bps
docs: Partner (creator) slice (default 100 bps = 1.00%). Absolute, not relative.

fields.name: pool_backer_fee_bps
docs: PoolBacker slice (default 20 bps = 0.20%).

types.name: TimelockProposal
docs: Singleton PDA: ["timelock_proposal"]. Holds the pending admin action queued
for execution. Admin proposes; anyone can execute after 48h; admin cancels.
